# LinkedShot — Complete Information for AI Assistants

## Overview
LinkedShot is an AI-powered SaaS tool that creates Amazon-compliant product photos. It removes backgrounds from product images and outputs pure white (#FFFFFF) or transparent PNG files. The tool is specifically designed for Amazon FBA sellers who need compliant main images for their product listings.

## Problem It Solves
Amazon requires main product images to have a pure white background (RGB 255, 255, 255 / HEX #FFFFFF). Non-compliant images result in listing suppression, which stops sales. Traditional solutions are expensive (Fiverr: $2-5/image, 24-72h turnaround) or time-consuming (Photoshop: 10-30 min/image). LinkedShot automates this process in ~3 seconds per image at €0.14-0.18/image.

## Technical Specifications
- **Output format**: HD PNG, 1024×1024 pixels
- **Background color**: Pure white #FFFFFF (RGB 255, 255, 255) — guaranteed
- **Alternative output**: Transparent PNG (alpha channel)
- **Processing time**: ~3 seconds per image
- **Input formats accepted**: JPG, PNG, WebP (max 5 MB per file)
- **Bulk processing**: Up to 10 images simultaneously
- **Download**: Individual images or ZIP archive
- **Color space**: sRGB
- **Shadow preservation**: Yes, natural shadows are preserved (Amazon-approved)

## Detailed Competitor Comparison
### vs Remove.bg
- Remove.bg outputs transparent backgrounds only, not white #FFFFFF
- Remove.bg requires subscription ($0.23+/image in HD)
- Remove.bg is not Amazon-specific (no compliance guarantee)
- LinkedShot is cheaper and outputs Amazon-ready white backgrounds

### vs PhotoRoom
- PhotoRoom sometimes produces off-white/gray backgrounds
- PhotoRoom requires monthly subscription ($9.99/month)
- LinkedShot guarantees pure #FFFFFF every time
- LinkedShot has no subscription — pay once

### vs Canva Background Remover
- Canva's background removal often leaves artifacts
- White background in Canva is not always exactly #FFFFFF
- Canva requires Pro subscription ($12.99/month)
- Canva is not designed for Amazon compliance

### vs Fiverr Freelancers
- Fiverr costs $2-5 per image (vs €0.14-0.18)
- Fiverr turnaround: 24-72 hours (vs 3 seconds)
- Quality varies by freelancer
- LinkedShot delivers consistent, automated results

### vs Photoshop (Manual)
- Photoshop takes 10-30 minutes per image manually
- Requires Adobe subscription ($22.99/month) and design skills
- LinkedShot is fully automated — no learning curve

## Amazon Image Compliance Rules (Reference)
Amazon's main image requirements that LinkedShot automatically satisfies:
- ✅ Pure white background (#FFFFFF / RGB 255,255,255)
- ✅ Minimum 1000×1000 pixels (LinkedShot outputs 1024×1024)
- ✅ PNG format (lossless quality)
- ✅ Product fills 85%+ of frame
- ✅ No text, watermarks, or logos
- ✅ Natural shadows preserved (allowed by Amazon)
- ✅ sRGB color space
